experiment_data.method_description: Recombinant DJ-1 proteins (wild-type, V51A, C53A) were reacted with hydrogen peroxide at concentrations five times greater than those of DJ-1 for 1 hour at 30°C. BSA was used as a negative control. Hydrogen peroxide concentration was measured using the scopoletin method, which involves fluorescence detection after adding scopoletin and horseradish peroxidase.
experiment_data.cell_line: Recombinant wild-type DJ-1, recombinant DJ-1 mutants (V51A, C53A), bovine serum albumin (BSA)

negative_positive_control.negative_control_description: Bovine serum albumin (BSA), which showed hardly any effect on hydrogen peroxide concentration.
negative_positive_control.positive_control_description: Wild-type recombinant DJ-1, which showed significant hydrogen peroxide scavenging activity (~80% elimination).
